ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 40:60 ratio of low-intensity (black) to high-intensity (white/light-gray) pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Centralized low-intensity contiguous regions extending bilaterally towards the mid-trailing edge. High-intensity pixels dominate the distal tips and leading edge perimeters with minor mottling.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an estimated 50 to 60-degree angle and vertical depth of approximately 15 percent of lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Left lobe trailing edge displays deep, irregular macro-indentations near the tip. Right lobe trailing edge displays high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the outer fifty percent of the margin.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curvature along the visible lower leading edges, tapering to acute distal points.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Deep, irregular mechanical-type notches on the outer trailing edge of the left lobe, distinct from natural serration patterns.
